scenarios.name: Bull
assumptions: HBM3e 12-high and early HBM4 volume ramp dominates next-generation Rubin and MI400 accelerator sockets with gross margins exceeding 52%.
PC and smartphone on-device AI models require standard 24GB-32GB DRAM, creating an acute global wafer capacity deficit and driving DDR5 blended ASPs up 30%.
Enterprise high-density QLC SSDs rapidly displace legacy HDDs in hyperscaler data centers, driving Storage business revenue past $35B.

scenarios.name: Base
assumptions: Full fiscal year 2027 revenue crosses $175B with corporate gross margin holding at 46.5% under 3-player oligopoly supply discipline.
Calendar 2026 and 2027 HBM production capacity remains 100% sold out under firm multi-quarter bilateral take-or-pay commitments.
Competitive HBM yields from Samsung and SK Hynix enter the market orderly without triggering irrational industry price cuts.

scenarios.name: Bear
assumptions: Cloud hyperscalers enter a multi-quarter AI server capacity digestion phase in late 2027, tempering memory bit shipment acceleration.
Samsung aggressively ramps 1c EUV DRAM wafer output, compressing commodity DDR5 server pricing by 25%.
Advanced packaging yield losses during 16-high HBM4 migration pressure corporate gross margin back toward 36%.
